finding: THE IMPLEMENTED ARM IS A REDUCED VERSION OF THE APPROVED PROPOSAL, AND THE REDUCTION REMOVES THE CANDIDATE'S ONLY DISTINCTIVE COMPONENT

the_frozen_v2_proposal.hypothesis_2: because the two factors are SEPARATELY SUPERVISED, the behaviour term can shape the L1 partition without moving the content factor's geometry, so the transfer failure of Case A/E is not forced

the_implemented_arm.so_the_implemented_mechanism_is: a product-metric level-0 ASSIGNMENT and nothing else: no factor mask, no behaviour term, no separately supervised factors

the_prior_art_around_what_was_implemente.why: a hyperbolic PRODUCT quantiser over multiple subquantisers with a hierarchy

the_prior_art_around_what_was_implemente.title: Differentiable Optimized Product Quantization and Beyond

consequence: What was implemented is a product-metric hyperbolic level-0 assignment, and that operator now sits in crowded prior art: a hyperbolic product quantiser with a hierarchy (HiHPQ), a hyperbolic codebook with a non-Euclidean assignment metric (HyperVQ), mixed-curvature product latent factors (mixed-curvature VAEs) and the differentiable product-quantisation machinery. The candidate's NOVELTY in the frozen proposal rested on the factor-ROLE supervision -- the masked gradient that lets the behaviour term shape one factor without touching the content factor's geometry -- and the implementation has no supervision at all. The JOIN E measured the reduced mechanism, and the reduced mechanism is not novel.
what_the_joins_mean: The JOIN E verdict stands as a measurement of what was implemented: the CGV's G1-G6 pass and the H gates are complete for the product-metric assignment. What the verdict does NOT establish is that the APPROVED PROPOSAL was implemented and verified -- the proposal's distinguishing component was dropped between the freeze and the tree, and the contract was narrowed to match the implementation, so the gate never saw the difference. That narrowing is the honest state to record, not a gate failure.

the_two_honest_options.a: re-implement the candidate with the factor-role supervision the proposal declares (the masked gradient: the content factor's codebook gradient from the reconstruction, the behaviour factor's from the train-split transition term, with the mask enforced in the backward), then a fresh join_R and join_E. This is the version whose novelty is not already occupied, and it is a path-A+B mechanism rather than the pure path-B assignment.
the_two_honest_options.b: re-declare the implemented arm as what it is -- a product-metric hyperbolic level-0 assignment -- and accept that its operator is prior art; that closes the candidate on novelty, and the campaign is then without an approvable candidate until a genuinely new operator is found.

the_lesson: The CGV verified the DECLARATION, and the declaration had been narrowed to match the implementation. A gate cannot catch a mechanism that is not in the declaration, so the declaration and the frozen proposal must be compared with each other -- a check that did not exist and that this campaign should add. The prior-art search is what made the mismatch visible at all: the operator that was implemented turned out to be crowded, so its missing role supervision stopped being a detail and became the whole claim.
the_state_of_the_candidate: NOT APPROVABLE AS IMPLEMENTED -- the two options above
